sql.query:
with p as (
  select id, creation_dt, reason from user_path
  where user_id = :P1::int and is_active
  order by id desc limit 1
), s as (
  select coalesce(ap.status, 'pending') as status
  from user_path_step ups
  join p on p.id = ups.user_path_id
  left join activity_progress ap on ap.user_id = :P1::int and ap.activity_id = ups.activity_id
)
select p.id as user_path_id, p.creation_dt as started_at,
       (select count(*) from s)::int as total,
       (select count(*) from s where status = 'done')::int as done,
       (select count(*) from s where status = 'failed')::int as failed,
       coalesce(round(100.0 * (select count(*) from s where status = 'done') / nullif((select count(*) from s), 0)), 0)::int as percent,
       not exists (select 1 from s where status <> 'done') as finished,
       p.reason
from p

select sk.id as skill_id, sk.code as skill_code, sk.title as skill_title,
       count(*)::int as total,
       count(*) filter (where ap.status = 'done')::int as done,
       count(*) filter (where ap.status = 'failed')::int as failed,
       coalesce(sum(ap.attempts), 0)::int as attempts,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where ap.status = 'done') / count(*))::int as percent,
       coalesce(max(a.level_n) filter (where ap.status = 'done'), 0)::int as level_reached
from user_path_step ups
join activity a on a.id = ups.activity_id
join skill sk on sk.id = ups.skill_id
left join activity_progress ap on ap.user_id = :P1::int and ap.activity_id = ups.activity_id
where ups.user_path_id = :P2::int
group by sk.id, sk.code, sk.title, sk.sort_order
order by sk.sort_order, sk.id
